fields.label: Username
fields.description: OCR Web Service username used as the HTTP Basic Auth username. Create an account or view your account from OCR Web Service: https://www.ocrwebservice.com/account/signup

fields.label: License Code
fields.description: OCR Web Service license code used as the HTTP Basic Auth password. Get it after signing in to your OCR Web Service account: https://www.ocrwebservice.com/account/login

actions.name: get_account_information
actions.description: Get OCR Web Service account limits, remaining pages, subscription plan, and expiration metadata.

inputSchema.description: Input parameters for getting OCR Web Service account information.

availablePages.description: The remaining available pages for the current subscription plan.

maxPages.description: The maximum pages for the current subscription plan.

anyOf.description: The last processing time returned by OCR Web Service.

lastProcessingTime.description: The last processing time returned by OCR Web Service.

anyOf.description: The license expiration date returned by OCR Web Service.

expirationDate.description: The license expiration date returned by OCR Web Service.

outputSchema.description: The normalized OCR Web Service account information.

actions.name: process_document_from_url
actions.description: Download a public image or PDF URL through the connector SSRF guard, upload it to OCR Web Service, and return extracted text or output file metadata.

fileUrl.description: The public HTTP or HTTPS URL of the image or PDF file to process.

items.description: One OCR Web Service recognition language, such as english or german.

languages.description: Recognition languages to send to OCR Web Service.

pageRange.description: Page numbers or ranges separated by commas, such as 1,3,5-12 or allpages.

toBlackAndWhite.description: Whether OCR Web Service should convert the image to black and white.

top.description: The top coordinate in pixels from the upper-left corner.

left.description: The left coordinate in pixels from the upper-left corner.

items.description: A rectangular OCR zone in pixel coordinates.

zones.description: OCR zones to process on each page.

items.description: An OCR Web Service output document format.

outputFormats.description: Output file formats to generate. OCR Web Service accepts up to two formats.

returnText.description: Whether OCR Web Service should return extracted text in the response.

returnWords.description: Whether OCR Web Service should return recognized word coordinates.

newline.description: Whether returned extracted text should preserve newline characters.

description.description: A task description that OCR Web Service returns in the response.

inputSchema.description: Input parameters for OCR Web Service document processing.

text.description: The extracted OCR text concatenated from all zones and pages.

items.description: The OCR text for one page.
The OCR text values for one zone.

ocrText.description: The raw OCR text matrix returned by OCR Web Service as zones by pages.

availablePages.description: The remaining available pages after this task.

processedPages.description: The number of pages processed for this task.

anyOf.description: The OCR Web Service output file URL when an output format was requested.

outputFileUrl.description: The OCR Web Service output file URL when an output format was requested.

anyOf.description: The task description echoed by OCR Web Service.

taskDescription.description: The task description echoed by OCR Web Service.

outputSchema.description: The normalized OCR Web Service document processing result.
